name: Remove Tract Outliers
summary: Removes outlier streamlines from each tract of a white matter classification by distance from the tract centroid and by length, using mbaComputeFibersOutliers.
description: Iteratively removes streamlines more than centroidSD standard deviations from the tract core or lengthSD from the mean length (up to maxIter passes) and saves a cleaned classification with tract JSONs; surfaces from the input are copied over. Use it on coherent, tract-like bundles; it is not meant for arbitrary streamline groupings.

inputs.requirements: Must index the streamlines of the given tractogram.
Streamline count must equal the length of the classification index.

outputs.description: Cleaned white matter classification (classification.mat) with tract JSONs and the input surfaces.

parameters.description: Cut streamlines which are this many standard deviations away from the tract centroid.
Cut streamlines which are this many standard deviations away from the tract average streamline length.
The maximum number of iterations to compute tract averages and apply a cut.

citations.text: Avesani P, McPherson B, Hayashi S, et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6, 69 (2019).

failure_modes.message: wmc(%d) and track fiber(%d) counts do not match
failure_modes.cause: The classification and tractogram come from different tracking runs.
failure_modes.fix: Use the tractogram that the classification was made from.
Check the log for a count mismatch or MATLAB error.
